note: Messages and rule citations of the scenarios, error and decoy operations (src/generate/index.js, ma-mutations.js and mutations.js). {op}, {type}, {what}, {min}, {max} and {known} are filled in by the code; nothing else is.

messages.noLine: {op}: the claim or line index given does not exist on this statement
messages.lineTaken: {op}: the line already carries an error or a decoy
messages.chargesNothing: {op}: the plan's rules charge the member nothing for this line, so the change has no effect
messages.capLeavesNothing: {op}: the out-of-pocket maximum leaves nothing more to charge the member this month
messages.capBelowDeductible: {op}: this month is too close to the out-of-pocket maximum to charge the deductible again; use a month further below it
messages.needsState: {op}: the scenario must set the prior out-of-pocket amount and, on the PPO, the deductible met
messages.notExemptLine: ma-cost-share-on-exempt-line: the line is not a $0 preventive or lab line
messages.notCoinsuranceLine: ma-reapply-deductible: the line is not a coinsurance line
messages.noCopay: ma-approved-below-copay: the line has no copay
messages.unknownField: {op}: the named total is not one of the claim totals the document prints
messages.badBy: {op}: the amount must be a nonzero whole number of cents no more than $100,000 either way, and positive where it adds to a charge or to what the patient is billed
messages.totalBelowZero: {op}: the change would make a printed claim total fall below zero
messages.badDays: {op}: the number of days must be a whole number from 1 to 365
messages.outsidePeriod: {op}: moving the repeat either way takes it outside the statement period
messages.sameDate: {op}: that date already has the same service
messages.repeatIsError: {op}: repeating this service within the period would itself be an error
messages.needsNote: ma-deny-line: the scenario must give the text of the denial note
messages.denialNoteTooLong: ma-deny-line: the denial note's text may be at most 500 characters and its rule at most 1,000 characters
messages.notPartialCap: ma-oop-cap-partial-share: the out-of-pocket maximum does not cut this line to a partial share
messages.notPartialDeductible: ma-partial-deductible: this line did not take part of the deductible
messages.unknownOp: The mutation operation named is not one this layout supports
messages.unknownDecoy: The decoy operation named is not one this layout supports
messages.decoyNeedsRule: A decoy must cite the rule that makes its line correct
messages.entryNeedsOp: A {what} entry must name its operation
messages.entryTextTooLong: A {what} entry may have a rule of at most 1,000 characters and a note of at most 500 characters
messages.priorOop: {type}: the prior out-of-pocket amount must be a whole number of cents between 0 and the plan's out-of-pocket maximum
messages.deductibleRange: {type}: the deductible already met must be a whole number of cents between 0 and the deductible for the year
messages.deductibleNeedsPrior: {type}: the deductible already met can only be set together with the prior out-of-pocket amount
messages.deductibleAbovePrior: {type}: the deductible already met cannot exceed the prior out-of-pocket amount, which includes it
messages.entryKindInvalid: A {what} entry's kind, if given, must be a lower-case slug (letters, digits, hyphens) of up to 64 characters
messages.entrySeverityInvalid: A {what} entry's severity, if given, must be one of info, low, medium or high
messages.denyNoteTooLong: deny-line: the denial note's text may be at most 500 characters and its rule at most 1,000 characters
messages.factorAtLeast: {op}: the factor must be at least {min} and at most {max}
messages.factorAbove: {op}: the factor must be more than {min} and at most {max}
messages.badRate: apply-cost-share-to-exempt-line: the rate must be more than 0 and at most 1
messages.noChange: {op}: after rounding to whole cents the amount stays the same, so there would be nothing to detect
messages.badMode: bill-above-approved: the mode must be unpaid-balance or extra
messages.billNothingAbove: bill-above-approved: the provider's charge minus the amount already paid does not exceed the patient's approved share, so nothing is left to bill above it
messages.badClaimCount: {type}: the number of claims must be a whole number between 1 and {max}
messages.badShape: {type}: each claim shape must be one of {known}, or left empty to have one drawn at random
messages.badYear: {type}: the reference data has no Medicare figures for the requested year
messages.badPeriod: {type}: the period must start and end on real calendar dates in the same calendar year, and its end date must not come before its start date
messages.badNoticeDate: {type}: the notice date must be a real calendar date no earlier than the last day of the period and no more than {max} days after it
messages.yearNotPeriod: {type}: a Medicare year, when given, must be the same calendar year in which the service period begins
messages.dupMovesLine: duplicate-line: a later line of the same claim already carries an error, and inserting the copy would shift that line so the error would point at the wrong line

rules.ruleDuplicate: The same service, code and date of service billed twice is a duplicate: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual (Pub. 100-04) ch. 1 §120.2, Exact Duplicates; CMS Recovery Audit topic 0091, Duplicate Claims
rules.rulePreventive: MA plans may not charge deductibles, copays or coinsurance for in-network Medicare-covered preventive services (42 CFR 422.100(k)), as defined in 42 CFR 410.152(l)
rules.ruleLab: Plan design, not a regulation: this plan's evidence of coverage and note L1 state that lab services are covered in full, so the member's share of a lab line is $0
rules.ruleDeductible: Plan design, from its evidence of coverage: one in-network deductible a year, then coinsurance (note C1); the cover shows it already met, so it cannot be charged again this year
rules.ruleOopMax: In-network out-of-pocket limit, 42 CFR 422.100(f)(4); per the plan's evidence of coverage, once the maximum is reached the plan pays the full approved amount for covered in-network services
rules.ruleDateAfterStatement: Internal consistency: a statement reports only services given on or before its statement date, so a service dated after that date cannot be right
rules.ruleDenial: Plan design for an in-network service denied without advance notice: the member owes nothing, consistent with 42 CFR 422.504(g)(1)(i); written denial notice under 42 CFR 422.568(d)-(e)
